The '''Time Piece Model 7643''' was a personal [[holograph]]ic [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]] manufactured by [[Gorondin Chronometrics]]. It was accurate to within a [[standard second]] per [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]]. However it was more than a simple chronometer &mdash; it could display holographic personalized messages. [[Jondris]] owned a Model 7643, and had images of his love, [[Madillis]], stored in his chronometer.
